mapper.select: select from basket_registration where id = #{id} and is_delete = 0
select from basket_registration where is_delete = 0 order by id desc
select from basket_registration where division_id = #{divisionId} and team_id = #{teamId} and is_delete = 0 limit 1

select r.id as registration_id, se.display_title as season_title, d.division_name, d.platform_code, r.team_id, t.team_name, r.captain_player_id, coalesce(p.game_nickname, mp.nickname) as captain_player_name, r.lineup_count, r.registration_status, r.submit_time from basket_registration r left join basket_season se on se.id = r.season_id and se.is_delete = 0 left join basket_division d on d.id = r.division_id and d.is_delete = 0 left join basket_team t on t.id = r.team_id and t.is_delete = 0 left join basket_player_profile p on p.id = r.captain_player_id and p.is_delete = 0 left join basket_member_profile mp on mp.member_id = r.captain_member_id and mp.is_delete = 0 where r.is_delete = 0 and r.season_id = #{seasonId} and r.division_id = #{divisionId} and r.registration_status = #{registrationStatus} and t.team_name like concat('%', #{teamName}, '%')
and coalesce(p.game_nickname, mp.nickname) like concat('%', #{captainPlayerName}, '%')
order by case when r.registration_status = 'PENDING_REVIEW' then 0 else 1 end, r.submit_time desc, r.id desc
select count(1) from basket_registration where division_id = #{divisionId} and registration_status = 'APPROVED' and is_delete = 0
select count(1) from basket_registration where division_id = #{divisionId} and is_delete = 0 and registration_status not in ('WITHDRAWN', 'CANCELLED')

where id = #{id} and is_delete = 0
